|errata_history=Versions of [[Yoda (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time]], in date order (2 versions). Slip texts are quoted as printed: ▼ and ▲ are the slips' arrow icons (deploy from / take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), and the immunity and pilot icons are the ones explained in each sheet's icon key (see [[Virtual card icons]]). Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Yoda (V) (Virtual Set 5)]]): first release sheet “Virtual Set #5” (Players Committee, 30 May 2003; tournament legal 6 June 2003), page 2, slip 25 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20030801181811/http://www.theforce.net/ccg/vcards/SWCCGVirtualSet5.pdf PDF on theforce.net] linked from the [https://web.archive.org/web/20030603182926/http://swccgpc.com:80/interior.htm PC news post of 30 May 2003] (Internet Archive capture of the PDF, 1 August 2003; PDF dated 30–31 May 2003): “May deploy to Dagobah. While mentoring, training destinies are +1. Once per turn, may ▼ Gimer Stick here. When you complete a Jedi Test, you may retrieve 3 Force, ignoring objective game text (may not be canceled except by Secret Plans). You retrieve no Force from Save You It Can.” Stats line: “POWER 3 ABILITY 7 JEDI MASTER”. Deploy 3, forfeit 9. The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “5•25” at bottom right and no expansion icon. The revised sheet of 11 June 2003 (PDF dated 11 June 2003; the copy the Players Committee still hosts at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards5.pdf res.starwarsccg.org]) prints the same words on the same old slip ([[:File:OVS5-25-Yoda-original-slip-2003-06-11.png]]).
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154714/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards5.pdf Internet Archive capture of 24 October 2007], slip 25), in the Committee's Remaster template: “May deploy to Dagobah. Retrieve 3 Force (ignore objective game text that prevents retrieval) when a Jedi Test is completed (may not be canceled except by Secret Plans). Retrieve no Force from Save You It Can. May deploy one Yoda’s Gimer Stick from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
